faqs.q: How long will my project take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope, permits and material lead times. We give a realistic schedule with the quote and tell you which items are most likely to move it.
PLACEHOLDER — confirm whether the client pulls permits and in which jurisdictions.

faqs.q: Will I have one point of contact?
faqs.a: Yes. Subcontractors are coordinated by us, not by you.
PLACEHOLDER — confirm the client's deposit and draw schedule before publishing.

faqs.q: Are you licensed, bonded and insured?
faqs.a: PLACEHOLDER — state actual licence number, bonding and insurance. Do not publish unverified.

faqs.q: Can I live in the house during the work?
faqs.a: Usually, for a single-room project. Whole-floor and kitchen work is harder — we will be straight with you about which weeks will be genuinely disruptive.
